question: In which of the following years was the Gajapati kingdom of Orissa established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1435**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Gajpati Kingdom of Odisha was established in **1435 **by **Emperor Kapilendra Deva.**
